title: Solarpunk Relic Device
flow_prompt: Holding a glowing solarpunk relic of brushed brass and vivid green mossy glass in her hand, the companion leans forward with a joyful, curious sparkle in her two glowing green eyes as the warm studio light catches the ancient etched runes on the device. She carefully twists a small sun-gold dial on the side, watches as the soft internal illumination pulses brightly against the clean studio backdrop, gives a cheerful hum of approval with a bright smile, and settles smoothly back into her starting pose. Locked static camera, clean solid white studio backdrop, no floating text or overlays. Audio: a soft, warm human hum of delight mixed with the crisp mechanical click of a brass dial turning and a subtle, airy chime of activation, recorded in a dry studio with no background music.
